integrity: Analytical proof; finite standard-library numerical diagnostics are supportive only. Originality checked against the 2025 and 2026 full texts with residual general-theorem risk.
scientific_limitations: Theorem assumes equal density dependence, unequal winter survival and strictly bistable positive annual multipliers. It does not address unequal density coefficients, within-season straightness, non-bistable boundaries, or general historical-priority completeness. The older continuous-time equal-crowding line is expressly credited.
title: Exact annual extinction-basin ray under unequal overwinter survival in the Aedes seasonal competition model
